أتتابع (form VI)
# أَتَتَابَعُ (ʔatatābaʕu) /ʔa.ta.taː.ba.ʕu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَتَابَعَ (tatābaʕa)
# أَتَتَابَعَ (ʔatatābaʕa) /ʔa.ta.taː.ba.ʕa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَتَابَعَ (tatābaʕa)
# أَتَتَابَعْ (ʔatatābaʕ) /ʔa.ta.taː.baʕ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَتَابَعَ (tatābaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
